conclusion: This LLM audit substitutes for the project's own previously-designed but never-executed 5-card human review content gate (docs/PM_V1_5_NEW_UNIFIED_PLAN_NEED_JUDGE_DATA_ZH.md Sec 8.2), at the user's explicit direction, because real human review is not being done now. It is explicitly a weaker status than the project's own human-verified convention -- cards are labeled llm_audit_qualified, not eligible_for_formal_rs (which remains false for every card). RS now has 79 real, content-diverse, LLM-audited strategy cards across all 5 families instead of a single generic fallback -- this unblocks designing real RS Step2 card-selection/ranking logic, which is a separate, still-unbuilt next step.
